findings.summary: The runtime translator has no production caller in this foundation slice.
findings.evidence: Plan 37-01 and Phase 37 D-05 explicitly defer the first live caller to PROV-01; SOURCE-01 remains a tested drift guard and cannot close Phase 37 as a facade.

findings.summary: The test does not state the full DataSource partition as one set-equality assertion.
findings.evidence: The same test suite proves five exact mapped destinations, three exact backend-only sources, disjointness, and the live enum currently contains exactly eight members; the equivalent 5+3 partition is complete on the accepted SHA.

findings.summary: The crosswalk is a not-yet-consumed contract in the current backend runtime.
findings.evidence: PROV-01 is the named dependency that must route mobile provenance ingestion through this function before Phase 37 closure; no user-facing path claims this slice is fully wired.

findings.summary: Mobile and backend comments expose deliberately different user-entry weights.
findings.evidence: DATA_LEDGER section 2.2 documents mobile userInput 0.60 versus backend user_entry 0.50 as by design; SOURCE-01 translates identities only and copies no weight.
